commit.message:
fix(memory): release held locks when the Streamable HTTP server stops

Over Streamable HTTP, run() never registered the exit hook that removes a
lock file the process still holds: only main(), the stdio path, called
installLockCleanup(). Closing the listener does not wait for a tool call
that is mid-write, so the process.exit() after it left the lock for the
next writer to wait out. A second signal took the default action, with no
exit event at all.

run() now registers the exit hook, and a second SIGINT or SIGTERM exits at
once with that signal's status, through the same hook.

Closes #5595
